Features

Everything you need to protect your digital infrastructure — powered by AI that never sleeps.

⚡

Real-Time Monitoring

Continuously monitors servers, logs, network traffic, and file systems around the clock. Every packet, every process, every change — CyberNova sees it all.

🛡️

AI Threat Detection

Separates real threats from false alarms using advanced AI-powered analysis. Instantly notifies and takes action automatically.

🔒

Auto-Quarantine

When threats are detected, CyberNova automatically blocks, isolates, and contains them in real time — no human intervention needed.

🌐

Full Infrastructure Coverage

From bare-metal servers to cloud instances, database files to network endpoints — protection across every asset.

📊

Intelligent Log Analysis

Filters massive log volumes to surface only actionable insights. Zero noise, maximum signal.

🚀

Zero-Downtime Response

Adaptive defense that never sleeps. Learns from every scan and adapts to new threats instantly.
